ev.q: The 363 SARS cases identified in the United States have been reported from 41 states
Of the 66 probable SARS patients, 43 (65%) were hospitalized, and two (3%) required mechanical ventilation.
Of the 66 probable SARS patients, 43 (65%) were hospitalized
Of 66 probable cases, 64 (97%) were attributed to international travel
with 297 (82%) cases classified as suspect SARS and 66 (18%) classified as probable SARS
This report updates SARS cases reported worldwide and in the United States
